description: Find Wikidata items (Q-ids) by name; the universal join key for Swiss municipalities, cantons, mountains, lakes, rivers, companies, people and institutions. Returns id, label, description and match. Set swiss_only=true to keep only items whose country (P17) or citizenship (P27) is Switzerland (Q39). Examples: 'Matterhorn', 'Lac Léman', 'Nestlé', 'ETH Zürich', 'Winterthur' (swiss_only=true). Follow up with get_wikidata_entity.

language.description: Search/label language: de, fr, it, rm or en (default en)

query.description: Name or label to search, e.g. 'Matterhorn', 'Roche', 'Aare'

swiss_only.description: Restrict to items with country or citizenship = Switzerland

name: search_wikidata
title: Search Wikidata entities
